items.raw_excerpt: This marks the first Games in 24 years where the sailors have gone without a gold.
items.summary_en: Singapore's sailing team ended its Asian Games campaign with three silvers and one bronze. It is the first time in 24 years that the sailors came home without a gold medal.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 요트 대표팀이 이번 아시안 게임에서 은메달 3개와 동메달 1개를 따내며 일정을 마쳤다. 선수단이 금메달 없이 대회를 마친 것은 24년 만이다.
items.title_en: Singapore's sailors finish Asian Games with three silvers and one bronze
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 요트 대표팀, 아시안 게임서 은메달 3개·동메달 1개로 마무리
items.title_original: Singapore’s sailors conclude Asian Games campaign with three silvers, one bronze

items.raw_excerpt: Expectativa é estimular uma reflexão coletiva sobre a forma como atribuímos valor aos alimentos e incentivar mudanças concretas de comportamento.
items.summary_en: A new campaign in Brazil wants people to think about how they value food. It hopes to inspire simple changes in daily habits. The goal is to cut down on wasted food.
items.summary_ko: 브라질에서 음식 낭비를 줄이려는 캠페인이 시작됐다. 음식에 어떤 가치를 두는지 함께 생각해 보자는 뜻을 담았다. 작은 습관 변화로 낭비를 줄이자는 것이 목표다.
items.title_en: Campaign asks people to waste less food
items.title_original: Campanha busca engajamento para reduzir desperdício de alimento

items.raw_excerpt: The 51-year-old former engineer first took up gelato-making more than 20 years ago as a side hustle. It has since become a lifelong passion, one that he continues to pursue through teaching and his home-based business, Ethos Gelato Lab.
items.summary_en: Chronos Chan is a 51-year-old former engineer in Singapore. He began making gelato over 20 years ago as a side job, and it grew into a lifelong passion. Now he teaches classes and runs a home business called Ethos Gelato Lab.
items.summary_ko: 크로노스 찬은 싱가포르에 사는 51세의 전직 엔지니어입니다. 20여 년 전 부업으로 젤라토를 만들기 시작했고, 그것이 평생의 열정이 되었습니다. 지금은 사람들을 가르치고 Ethos Gelato Lab이라는 홈 사업을 운영합니다.
items.title_en: He puts seaweed and soy sauce in gelato
items.title_ko: 해조류와 간장을 젤라토에 넣는 싱가포르의 크로노스 찬
items.title_original: Why Chronos Chan puts seaweed, soy sauce and Sichuan pepper in gelato – and what drives his unusual creations

items.raw_excerpt: During the week between 5 October and 11 October, fuel prices for both diesel and gasoline will continue to fall.
items.summary_en: Fuel prices in Portugal will keep going down this week. Both diesel and gasoline are getting cheaper from 5 to 11 October. Drivers can expect lower prices at the pump.
items.summary_ko: 이번 주 포르투갈의 연료 가격이 계속 내려간다. 10월 5일부터 11일까지 디젤과 휘발유 값이 모두 떨어진다. 운전자들은 더 낮은 가격을 기대할 수 있다.
items.title_en: Fuel prices keep falling in Portugal

items.raw_excerpt: Κανονικά προγραμματίζονται τα βραδινά ταξίδια προς Κρήτη
items.summary_en: Night trips to Crete are back on their normal schedule. Ferry routes from the ports of Piraeus and Rafina are slowly returning to normal after bad weather eased. Workers are working to bring back the full service.
items.summary_ko: 악천후가 잦아들면서 피레아스와 라피나 항구에서 출발하는 여객선 운항이 조금씩 정상으로 돌아오고 있다. 크레타로 가는 야간 운항도 다시 정상 일정으로 돌아왔다. 항만 쪽은 모든 노선을 완전히 되살리기 위해 작업하고 있다.
items.title_en: Ferry Trips from Piraeus and Rafina Return Slowly as Weather Calms
items.title_ko: 날씨가 풀리며 피레아스와 라피나 여객선 운항이 조금씩 정상화

items.raw_excerpt: TRE busca garantir isonomia e integridade física das eleitoras
items.summary_en: Women with protective orders will have priority when voting in Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil. The regional electoral court wants a safe and equal voting process for them.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 리우그란지두노르치주에서 보호명령을 받은 여성이 투표할 때 우선권을 갖게 된다. 지역 선거법원은 이들의 안전하고 평등한 투표를 보장하려 한다.
items.title_en: Women with protective orders get priority to vote in Rio Grande do Norte

items.title_original: Mulheres com medidas protetivas terão prioridade para votar no RN

items.raw_excerpt: The point-in-time count was scheduled for Tuesday, and about 250 volunteers had been trained.
items.summary_en: The city of Saskatoon called off its plan to count unsheltered people in person. The count was set for Tuesday, and about 250 volunteers had already been trained. The city said safety concerns led to the change.
items.summary_ko: 새스카툰시가 노숙인을 직접 만나 세는 조사를 취소했다. 조사는 화요일에 예정돼 있었고, 약 250명의 자원봉사자가 이미 교육을 받은 상태였다. 시는 안전 우려 때문에 계획을 바꿨다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Saskatoon cancels in-person count of unsheltered people
items.title_original: City of Saskatoon cancels in-person count of unsheltered people over safety concerns

items.raw_excerpt: For Hannah Mia Neo Labude, a love of craft-making has led to lessons in running her own business while in school, collaborating with partners and helping causes close to her heart.
items.summary_en: Hannah Mia Neo Labude loves making crafts. This hobby led her to start her own small business while still in school. She works with partners and supports causes she cares about.
items.summary_ko: 한나 미아 네오 라부데는 손으로 만드는 공예를 좋아한다. 이 취미 덕분에 학교에 다니면서 작은 사업을 시작하게 되었다. 그녀는 여러 사람과 함께 일하며 마음에 두는 일을 돕고 있다.
items.title_en: Girl Starts Her First Business at Age 11
items.title_original: What I learnt from starting my first business at age 11

October is a month of contrasts: crisp mornings, long evenings, changing weather and the first hints of winter. It is also a perfect time to slow down, put on your headphones and indulge…
items.summary_en: October brings shorter days and changing weather to Iceland. This playlist offers music to match the cozy autumn mood.

items.raw_excerpt: Governor urges IIIT-Kottayam students to master technology responsibly, maintain education quality, and pursue youth social responsibility amid AI concerns.
items.summary_en: The Governor of Kerala spoke to students at IIIT Kottayam. He asked them to use technology in a responsible way. He also told them to keep up education quality and help society.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라 주지사가 코타얌의 IIIT 학생들과 만나 이야기를 나눴다. 그는 학생들에게 기술을 책임 있게 사용하라고 당부했다. 또 교육의 질을 지키고 사회에 기여하라고 말했다.

items.raw_excerpt: The government today authorised the City Council to obtain surface rights over a plot of land belonging to the Polytechnic University of Viana do Castelo (UPVC) to build a Technology and Innovation Centre for Ocean Energy and Technologies.
items.summary_en: The Portuguese government approved a land deal for a new centre in Viana do Castelo. The city will get surface rights over land owned by the local polytechnic university. The centre will study ocean energy and new marine technologies.

items.title_en: Portugal gives land for a new ocean energy centre

items.title_original: Portugal grants land for ocean energy centre

items.summary_en: Recife has opened a new plaza and sports field for local residents. The upgrades will give families more space for play and exercise.
